title: Handling Offers & Negotiations from the Seller Side
excerpt: In a balanced market, low offers are common on homes that have sat or show condition issues.
body:
People searching Austin-area real estate for “how to negotiate as a seller Austin”, “responding to low offers real estate”, and “multiple offers seller strategy Texas” want a local, practical answer.

In a balanced market, low offers are common on homes that have sat or show condition issues. Respond with data (recent comps), a clear counter, or a willingness to walk away.

Escalation clauses, appraisal-gap coverage, and flexible closing or lease-back terms can strengthen a buyer’s position without necessarily raising the price.

Keep emotion out of the first response. A calm, numbers-based approach preserves leverage.
